_readme: Park's task catalog. game: word | excel | copier | stamp | coffee | bow. station: where Jonaid does it (see stations). deadline is in game minutes (office clock: 0.75 game-min per real second). pay in won. weight = how often it's picked. min_day = first day it can appear. params are passed to the minigame.

tasks.title: Retype my email. BIGGER.
tasks.line: My email to the director. Retype it. Bigger font. The font was the problem.

params.text: Dear Director Choi, the numbers are fine. Please ignore the numbers.

tasks.title: 'Dear' -> 'Most Esteemed'
tasks.line: Change every 'Dear' to 'Most Esteemed'. Respect is a font size.

params.text: Most Esteemed Director, Most Esteemed Team, Most Esteemed Printer,

tasks.title: My daughter's birthday card
tasks.line: Write my daughter's birthday card. Make it sound like me.

params.text: Happy birthday. Study hard. Work harder. Love, Department Head Park

tasks.title: Apology letter to the printer
tasks.line: Write an apology to the printer. It knows what it did.

params.text: Dear printer, I am sorry. Please print. Regards, Team 3

tasks.title: 'No Comic Sans' x3
tasks.line: Type 'I will not use Comic Sans' three times. HR wants proof.

params.text: I will not use Comic Sans. I will not use Comic Sans. I will not use Comic Sans.

tasks.title: Rename the report
tasks.line: The report title is wrong. Fix it. FINAL, final.

tasks.title: Q3 numbers from my napkin
tasks.line: Put the Q3 numbers in Excel. They're on this napkin. Don't ask about the stain.

tasks.title: Sum it BY HAND
tasks.line: Add up the column. By hand. I don't trust formulas. Formulas have agendas.

tasks.title: Golf expenses (business)
tasks.line: Enter my golf expenses. They're business expenses. Golf IS business.

tasks.title: Unjam the copier
tasks.line: The copier jammed. Again. Fix it with your HANDS.

tasks.title: The copier ate my report
tasks.line: The copier ATE my report. Get it out. Gently. It's sensitive.

tasks.title: Stamp the approvals
tasks.line: Stamp these approvals. All of them. Don't read them.

tasks.title: Deny the vacation requests
tasks.line: Vacation requests. Stamp them all DENIED. Except mine. Mine is red.

tasks.title: Park's coffee. EXACTLY.
tasks.line: Coffee. You know how I like it. (You don't.)

tasks.title: Coffee for the clients
tasks.line: Clients are here. Coffee. Make it look expensive.

tasks.title: BOW to Director Choi
tasks.line: Director Choi is in the meeting room. Go BOW. Ninety degrees. Not eighty-nine.
